editorial:
You know that feeling when you and your best friend are about to graduate and realize your whole world is about to change? That's the heart of this comedy. Two awkward high school seniors, Seth and Evan, are desperate to score booze for a big party so they can impress girls before college pulls them apart. Their plan goes sideways fast, and what follows is a wild night full of bad decisions, fake IDs, and a couple of cops who are way too friendly. The vibe is loud, crude, and surprisingly sweet underneath all the chaos.

The acting is fantastic, especially the chemistry between the leads, and the pacing never lets up. The jokes land hard, though some moments are pretty raunchy and might not be for everyone. If you love coming-of-age comedies with heart, you'll have a blast. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: After a night of chaos, Seth and Evan finally make it to the party, but things don't go as planned. Seth ends up with a girl but things get awkward, while Evan has a sweet moment with his crush. The next morning, the two friends run into each other at the mall and realize their friendship will survive even as they head to different colleges. It's a warm, funny ending that shows growing up doesn't mean growing apart.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raunchy coming-of-age comedies with heart.
